description: Implementation of the absl::Time class and related time zone conversions, including functions for time breakdowns, conversions, and handling infinite time values within the absl library.

classes.name: absl::Time
classes.description: Represents a point in time with methods for conversion and breakdown.

classes.name: absl::TimeZone
classes.description: Represents a time zone with methods for time conversions and transition handling.

methods.name: Time::In
methods.description: Returns the breakdown of the time in a specified time zone.

methods.name: FromUDate
methods.description: Converts a double representing a date in UDate format to absl::Time.

methods.name: FromUniversal
methods.description: Converts a universal timestamp to absl::Time.

methods.name: ToUnixNanos
methods.description: Converts absl::Time to Unix nanoseconds.

methods.name: ToUnixMicros
methods.description: Converts absl::Time to Unix microseconds.

methods.name: ToUnixMillis
methods.description: Converts absl::Time to Unix milliseconds.

methods.name: ToUnixSeconds
methods.description: Converts absl::Time to Unix seconds.

methods.name: ToTimeT
methods.description: Converts absl::Time to time_t.

methods.name: ToUDate
methods.description: Converts absl::Time to UDate double format.

methods.name: ToUniversal
methods.description: Converts absl::Time to a universal timestamp.

methods.name: TimeFromTimespec
methods.description: Creates absl::Time from a timespec structure.

methods.name: TimeFromTimeval
methods.description: Creates absl::Time from a timeval structure.

methods.name: ToTimespec
methods.description: Converts absl::Time to a timespec structure.

methods.name: ToTimeval
methods.description: Converts absl::Time to a timeval structure.

methods.name: FromChrono
methods.description: Creates absl::Time from a std::chrono::system_clock::time_point.

methods.name: ToChronoTime
methods.description: Converts absl::Time to std::chrono::system_clock::time_point.

methods.name: TimeZone::At
methods.description: Returns civil info for a given time.

methods.name: TimeZone::At
methods.description: Returns time info for a given civil second.

methods.name: ConvertDateTime
methods.description: Converts date and time components into a Time object considering time zone.

methods.name: FromTM
methods.description: Creates absl::Time from a struct tm and time zone.

methods.name: ToTM
methods.description: Converts absl::Time to a struct tm in a specified time zone.
